# Minimal deps to run the alpaca_trading domain through domains/harness.py /
# domains/report.py and its test suite -- NOT upstream's full requirements.txt,

# doesn't touch. `docker` and `GitPython` are here only because utils/gl_utils.py
# imports them at module level (needed to reach utils.gl_utils.get_score/
# select_parent in tests); no Docker daemon or git repo access is required to
# run this domain's own tests.
